fields.name: method
fields.description: The way the demonstration moved the cube, fixed at the first decision step from the demonstration steps and never changed afterwards. Decide it from the TRANSPORT frames of the demonstration (the frames in which the cube is sliding or carried toward the target) and from the greatest height the gripper reaches while anything is marked as held, never from a single finger reading during the closing motion: a reading of roughly 19-30% that drops to about 0% at the next frame is a closing transient, not a grasp. Write `pick` when the demonstration shows the cube marked as held in the gripper while the gripper rises well above the table (height above about 0.08) with fingers partly closed around it (about 40-60% open), and the cube is then released over the target. Write `hook` when the demonstration shows the stick (peg) marked as held in the gripper, with fingers settled at about 20-25% and staying there through the transport frames, the gripper rising well above the table (height above about 0.08) with the stick before coming down to drag the stick against the cube toward the target. Write `push` when, in the transport frames, the fingers read about 0% (closed on nothing) and the gripper height stays at table level (below about 0.04) throughout, and neither cube nor stick is ever marked as held while the gripper is raised. This is `push` even if the gripper descended beside the stick, the fingers passed through roughly 19-30% for a frame while closing before reaching 0%, the stick's head was listed near the gripper, or the stick ended up shoved to a new spot as the gripper swept past it. Same value at every step of the episode. e.g. hook
